import json, subprocess, sys, time
def timeit(req, tag, reps=1):
    line = json.dumps(req).encode()+b'\n'
    t0=time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                       input=line*reps, capture_output=True)
    t1=time.time()
    out = json.loads(p.stdout.split(b'\n')[0])
    n = len(out['dfa']['accept']) if out.get('ok') else out
    print('%-14s rc=%d wall=%.2fs out=%.2fMB states=%s' %
          (tag, p.returncode, t1-t0, len(p.stdout)/1e6, n if isinstance(n,int) else n))
    return out

svcs = ['t%d' % i for i in range(7)] + ['a','b','c'] + ['u%d' % i for i in range(14)]
args = [{'op':'contains','path':['t%d' % i]} for i in range(7)] + \
       [{'op':'contains','path':['a']*16}, {'op':'contains','path':['b']*16},
        {'op':'contains','path':['c']*8}]
timeit({'services': svcs, 'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'and','args':args}}],
        'queries': [['a']*4096, [], ['t0','a','b','c']]}, 'heavy-19968')

        [{'op':'contains','path':['b%d'%i]} for i in range(4)]

        'queries': []}, 'runs-7936')

         {'op':'contains','path':['c']*16}, {'op':'startswith','path':['a','b','c']*5},
         {'op':'match','path':['a']*16}]

# many rules, wide boolean structure
import random
rnd = random.Random(4)
svcs4 = ['s%d'%i for i in range(24)]
rules = []
for i in range(32):
    args = [{'op': rnd.choice(['contains','endswith','startswith','match']),
             'path': [rnd.choice(svcs4) for _ in range(rnd.randint(1,16))]}
            for _ in range(rnd.randint(1,4))]
    rules.append({'action': rnd.choice(['allow','drop']),
                  'when': {'op':'or','args':args}})
timeit({'services': svcs4, 'rules': rules, 'queries': []}, 'wide-rules')
